//    Hub's own data (d.subs) holds that submission.
// 2. Bandmaster alert: each change is posted to Joe's Home Assistant, which shows it on his phone with a
//    Note button. Note calls api=bmnote, which marks it noted here at once and lists it in bmnoted.json
//    for Claude's hourly check to note in the Hub.
// 3. Member alerts (web push): members choose alerts in the app's Settings. tick() runs every minute,
//    keeps the data cache warm and sends alerts for new Notes from the BM, music pushes and noted changes.
// Run setupLive() once from the editor after deploying (creates the minute trigger, asks for permissions).

var API_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyicvqPU2m1jZ4yLrbjZCFO2o-fEr2UdV1A44Wgd8dOGOhgwjMjfH__ndfWq8qbjNDX/exec';
var HA_WEBHOOK = '__HA_WEBHOOK__';
var PUSH_SUBJECT = 'mailto:joe@mciver.net.au';
var MON_ = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

function setupLive() {
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (t) { if (t.getHandlerFunction() === 'tick') ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t); });
  ScriptApp.newTrigger('tick').timeBased().everyMinutes(1).create();
  getVapid_();
  UrlFetchApp.getRequest('https://www.google.com');   // asks for the "connect to an external service" permission
  tick();
  Logger.log('Live updates are set up. Alert key: ' + getVapid_().publicKey.slice(0, 12) + '...');
}

// ----- parsing what the band page sends: "Wed 14/10/2026 (holidays); Sun 18/10/2026 AVAILABLE" -----

  var out = [];
  String(dates || '').split(/;\s*/).forEach(function (x) {
    x = x.trim(); var m = x.match(/^(\w{3})\s+(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})\s*(.*)$/); if (!m) return;
    var iso = m[4] + '-' + ('0' + m[3]).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + m[2]).slice(-2), rest = m[5] || '', k = 'away', r = '';

  var p = iso.split('-'), dt = new Date(Number(p[0]), Number(p[1]) - 1, Number(p[2])), sun = dt.getDay() === 0;

  var g = { away: [], avail: [], cancel: [], undo: [] };
  items.forEach(function (i) { g[i.k].push(liveLabel_(i.d) + (i.r ? ' (' + i.r + ')' : '')); });
  var out = [];
  if (g.away.length) out.push('Away: ' + g.away.join(', '));

function liveState_() { try { return JSON.parse(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('live') || '[]') || []; } catch (e) { return []; } }

// Called from doGet (inside its lock) right after the row is written.
function liveAdd_(name, dates, ts) {
  try {
    var d = loadData_(); if (!d) return null;
    var mem = null; (d.members || []).forEach(function (m) { if (m.formName === name) mem = m; });
    var items = liveItems_(dates); if (!items.length) return null;
    var e = { sub: 'form-' + Utilities.formatDate(ts instanceof Date ? ts : new Date(), 'Australia/Sydney', 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'),
      m: mem ? mem.id : '', name: mem ? mem.name : name, at: new Date().toISOString(), items: items, tok: hex_(8), noted: false };
    if (mem) {
      var cutoff = Date.now() - 4 * 86400000;
      var list = liveState_().filter(function (x) { return new Date(x.at).getTime() > cutoff; });
      list.push(e); while (JSON.stringify(list).length > 8500 && list.length > 1) list.shift();
      liveSave_(list);
    }
    return e;
  } catch (err) { return null; }
}

// Apply live changes on top of the published data (for api=data and the tinyurl page).

  var list = liveState_(); if (!list.length) return d;
  var subs = d.subs || {}, pub = new Date(d.updatedAt || 0).getTime();
  list.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.at < b.at ? -1 : 1; }).forEach(function (e) {
    var s = subs[e.sub];
    if (s && (!e.noted || s[0] !== 'pending')) return;          // the Hub has it now
    if (pub - new Date(e.at).getTime() > 2 * 3600000) return;   // safety: a much newer publish
    var mem = null; d.members.forEach(function (m) { if (m.id === e.m) mem = m; }); if (!mem) return;
    e.items.forEach(function (i) {
      var ix = d.sessions.indexOf(i.d); if (ix < 0) return; var c = mem.cells[ix] || '', n = c;
      if (i.k === 'away') n = e.noted ? 'x' : (c === 's' || c === 'x') ? c : 'p';
      else if (i.k === 'avail') n = e.noted ? '' : (c === 'x' || c === 's') ? 'r' : c;
      else if (i.k === 'cancel') n = (c === 'p' || e.noted) ? '' : (c === 'x' ? 'r' : c);
      else if (i.k === 'undo') n = e.noted ? 'x' : (c === 'r' ? 'x' : c === '' ? 'p' : c);

    if (!e) return { ok: false, error: 'not found' };

function pushSubs_() {
  var all = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties(), out = [];
  for (var k in all) if (k.indexOf('ps_') === 0) { try { var s = JSON.parse(all[k]); s.key = k; out.push(s); } catch (e) {} }
  return out;
}
function subscribe_(p) {
  var ep = String(p.ep || ''); if (ep.indexOf('https://') !== 0 || !p.p || !p.a) return { ok: false, error: 'bad subscription' };
  var s = { m: String(p.m || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '').slice(0, 60), ep: ep, p: String(p.p), a: String(p.a),
    prefs: String(p.prefs || '').split(',').filter(function (x) { return /^(notes|music|noted)$/.test(x); }), at: new Date().toISOString() };
  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty(subKey_(ep), JSON.stringify(s));
  if (p.test) { s.key = subKey_(ep); sendPush_(s, { title: 'Band alerts are on', body: 'You\'ll get alerts from the Wollongong Salvo Band on this phone.', tag: 'welcome' }, {}); }
  return { ok: true };
}
function unsubscribe_(ep) { PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().deleteProperty(subKey_(String(ep || ''))); return { ok: true }; }
function toSigned_(u8) { var a = new Array(u8.length); for (var i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) a[i] = u8[i] > 127 ? u8[i] - 256 : u8[i]; return a; }
function sendPush_(s, msg, cache) {
  try {
    var v = getVapid_(), aud = s.ep.match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/)[0];
    if (!cache[aud]) cache[aud] = WP.vapidHeader(s.ep, PUSH_SUBJECT, v.publicKey, v.privateKey, Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
    var body = WP.encrypt(s.p, s.a, JSON.stringify(msg), rnd_(32), rnd_(16));
    var r = UrlFetchApp.fetch(s.ep, { method: 'post', contentType: 'application/octet-stream', payload: toSigned_(body), muteHttpExceptions: true,
      headers: { Authorization: cache[aud], TTL: '86400', 'Content-Encoding': 'aes128gcm', Urgency: 'high' } });
    var code = r.getResponseCode();
    if (code === 404 || code === 410) PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().deleteProperty(s.key);   // phone unsubscribed
    return code;
  } catch (e) { return 0; }
}
function pushTo_(filter, msg) { var cache = {}, n = 0; pushSubs_().forEach(function (s) { if (filter(s)) { sendPush_(s, msg, cache); n++; } }); return n; }

// ----- every minute: keep the data warm, tidy live changes, send member alerts -----
function tick() {
  var d = loadData_(false, true); if (!d) return;
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock(); if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) return;
  try {
    var subs = d.subs || {}, pub = new Date(d.updatedAt || 0).getTime();
    var list = liveState_(), keep = list.filter(function (e) { var s = subs[e.sub];
      if (s && (!e.noted || s[0] !== 'pending')) return false;
      return pub - new Date(e.at).getTime() < 2 * 3600000 && Date.now() - new Date(e.at).getTime() < 4 * 86400000; });
    if (keep.length !== list.length) liveSave_(keep);
  } finally { lock.releaseLock(); }
  pushEvents_(d);
}

function pushEvents_(d) {
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties(), st = null;
  try { st = JSON.parse(props.getProperty('pushState') || 'null'); } catch (e) { st = null; }
  var notes = {}; (d.notes || []).forEach(function (n) { notes[n.id] = n.v; });
  var subs = {}; Object.keys(d.subs || {}).forEach(function (k) { subs[k] = d.subs[k][0]; });
  var now = { notes: notes, musicAt: d.musicAt || '', subs: subs };
  if (!st) { props.setProperty('pushState', JSON.stringify(now)); return; }   // first run: remember, send nothing
  (d.notes || []).forEach(function (n) {
    if (st.notes[n.id] === n.v) return;
    var txt = String(n.text || ''); if (txt.length > 180) txt = txt.slice(0, 177) + '...';
    pushTo_(function (s) { return s.prefs.indexOf('notes') >= 0; }, { title: 'Message from the Bandmaster', body: txt, tag: 'note-' + n.id });
  });
  if (now.musicAt && now.musicAt !== st.musicAt)
    pushTo_(function (s) { return s.prefs.indexOf('music') >= 0; }, { title: 'Band music updated', body: 'See what we\'re playing at practice and on Sunday.', tag: 'music' });
  var bm = {}; try { bm = JSON.parse(props.getProperty('bmNoted') || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) {}
  Object.keys(d.subs || {}).forEach(function (k) {
    var s = d.subs[k], prev = st.subs[k];
    if (s[0] === 'approved' && prev === 'pending' && !bm[k] && s[1])
      pushTo_(function (x) { return x.m === s[1] && x.prefs.indexOf('noted') >= 0; }, { title: 'Noted by the Bandmaster', body: 'The Bandmaster has noted your update.', tag: 'noted-' + k });
  });
  props.setProperty('pushState', JSON.stringify(now));
}
